observations.finding: Edge preparation and roller application. Captioned warning about rapid rolling/bubbles.
Sanding/edge-gap inspection and color application; avoid excessive side overflow.
Heat-tool discussion, not copied as a default heating recipe. 450°C in ASR refers to tool maximum, not measured treatment temperature.
Short flexing of edge-coated sample; no independent cycle-count/lifetime measurement.

videos.limits: Creator says he had not tried separate basecoat in captions around19:07 and23:19. His colored-coat demonstration is not misreported as primer application. Personal dilution/storage/heat advice not generalized.

cross_review: Manufacturer instructions take priority over copying the maker demonstration as an identical basecoat process.
Creator explicitly had not tested separate primer; distinguish his colored-coat method from manufacturer primer advice.
Product family, substrate oiliness and layer condition affect application; no universal sanding grit or coat count.
2017 drying article is historical general guidance, not a current product TDS or universal curing guarantee.
450°C tool maximum is not a working temperature; heat treatment omitted from baseline procedure.
Short flexing is not an independent repeated-bend/wear test.
A mismatched descriptive paragraph on Basecoat Dense Academy page was not adopted as primer specification.
Weaver fold allowance idea concerns actual inner/outer path difference, not exterior bulge height.
Own circular-arc formula deltaL=theta*d is an ideal geometric explanation, not a calibrated pattern allowance.
